summary: Co-Diagnostics filed an 8-K/A amending its October 13, 2026 report to add a revised ATM Waterfall Distribution Agreement removing Maxim Group LLC as a party and an ATM Payment Direction Letter directing Maxim to remit at-the-market offering proceeds to a specified deposit account. The amendment also restates Item 1.01 covering an October 9, 2026 senior secured convertible loan agreement with J.J. Astor Co. for up to $3.1 million, including a $2.835 million initial note at a 1.35x factor rate and 4% origination fee. This is a financing and administrative exhibit amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
